hero_title: Your Perfect Stay in Paradise
hero_subtitle: Experience the quiet harmony of tropical gardens, warm teak interiors, and true Balinese hospitality.

rooms.name: Deluxe Room
rooms.desc: Spacious and elegant room with a private balcony and lush tropical garden views.

rooms.name: Pool Villa
rooms.desc: Your private walled sanctuary with a plunge pool, outdoor daybed, and serene privacy.

rooms.name: Family Room
rooms.desc: Generous living space crafted for loved ones to gather and create lasting island memories.

spa.title: Botanical Sanctuary Spa
spa.subtitle: Rooted in ancient Balinese healing traditions using wild-harvested frangipani, warm volcanic river stones, and virgin coconut oil.

treatments.name: Serenity Balinese Massage
treatments.desc: Deep rhythmic palm pressure and long sweeping strokes infused with warm sandalwood and ylang-ylang oil to release muscular tension.

treatments.name: Volcanic Warm Stone Ritual
treatments.desc: Smooth basalt stones heated in aromatic herbal water are placed along energy meridians to calm the nervous system.

treatments.name: Royal Lulur & Flower Bath
treatments.desc: Traditional Javanese turmeric and jasmine rice polish followed by a cooling yogurt mask and a private frangipani petal soak.

treatments.name: Couples Harmony Journey
treatments.desc: Side-by-side Balinese massage, organic facial refresh, and candlelit tropical flower bath in our secluded garden suite.

dining.title: Coastal & Balinese Kitchen
dining.subtitle: Line-caught Jimbaran seafood, organic Bedugul harvest, and slow-roasted island spices served beside the infinity pool.

tasting.name: Jimbaran Scallop Crudo
tasting.desc: Wild-caught Lombok scallop cured in kaffir lime, torch ginger flower, and coconut dressing.

tasting.name: Lemongrass Duck Broth
tasting.desc: Clear aromatic Balinese consommé with shredded heritage duck, charred shallots, and bok choy.

tasting.name: Charcoal Red Snapper
tasting.desc: Basted in turmeric-lemongrass paste over coconut husks, served with sambal matah and red rice.

tasting.name: Black Rice Brulee
tasting.desc: Caramelized Balinese injin pudding topped with toasted coconut flakes and vanilla bean gelato.

coastal.name: Bebek Betutu Slow Roast
coastal.desc: 12-hour banana-leaf braised organic duck with bumbu genep, lawar greens, and sambal embe.

coastal.name: Nusa Dua King Prawns
coastal.desc: Wood-fired jumbo prawns glazed in tamarind-honey butter with charred asparagus and lime.

coastal.name: Bedugul Harvest Bowl
coastal.desc: Roasted pumpkin, spiced tempeh, avocado, pickled red cabbage, and sesame-ginger emulsion.

coastal.name: Hand-Cut Crab Tagliolini
coastal.desc: Blue swimmer crab tossed with garlic confit, chili flakes, lemon zest, and white wine.

morning.name: Serenity Dragonfruit Bowl
morning.desc: Blended red dragonfruit, mango, homemade cashew granola, chia seeds, and wild island honey.

morning.name: Poached Eggs & Avocado
morning.desc: Country sourdough, organic Kintamani eggs, whipped feta, dukkah spice, and cherry tomatoes.

morning.name: Pandan Coconut Pancakes
morning.desc: Fluffy pandan-infused stack layered with caramelized banana and warm gula aren syrup.

morning.name: Kintamani Pour Over
morning.desc: Light-roasted Arabica beans grown on volcanic slopes, brewed tableside.

drinks.name: Uluwatu Sunset Spritz
drinks.desc: Rosella hibiscus reduction, blood orange, prosecco, and fresh garden rosemary.

drinks.name: Smoked Pineapple Mezcalita
drinks.desc: Charred Bali pineapple, artisanal mezcal, kaffir lime leaf, and sea salt rim.

drinks.name: Jamu Kunyit Asam Tonic
drinks.desc: Fresh turmeric root, tamarind, wild honey, and sparkling mineral water.

drinks.name: Cucumber & Basil Cooler
drinks.desc: Cold-pressed cucumber, sweet Thai basil, yuzu citrus, and elderflower.
